screen.grandcraft.choose_class: Choose your class — this choice is permanent!
screen.grandcraft.config.title: Combat Tuning
screen.grandcraft.config.stagger_reset.t: Ticks without a hit before the stagger sequence resets. Below about 15 this expires between ordinary consecutive swings, so the strong/weak/none sequence stops forming.
screen.grandcraft.config.stagger_jump.to: How much jump strength is removed while staggered. Movement speed only governs ground acceleration, so without this a staggered target can jump and carry its momentum straight through the slowdown.
screen.grandcraft.config.knockback_resis: Knockback resistance held by all GrandCraft combatants at all times, not just while staggered. Vanilla knockback throws a target far enough that a short stagger expires before they land. Higher means they stay put and the stagger is actually felt.
commands.grandcraft.reclass.success: %s has been reset to Peasant and may choose a new class
